comments.body: Settled by MIP-3: the daemon replays a pane's history and the surface keeps its own scrollback built from that replay, so Ghostty's search works (docs/architecture.md, data plane).

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Daemon owns truth; decide how much the local surface caches and who answers a scroll event. Interacts with herdr's alt-screen and copy-mode behavior.
title: Scrollback strategy
